tspan.tspan: Extreme poverty in India fell from 27% to under 3% in 12 years
(₹68 at 2023‐24 prices), the World Bank’s extreme poverty line:
37 million people, down from 344 million in 2011‐12. At $8.30 (₹187), 80% still fall below.
Source: World Bank, Poverty and Inequality Platform (September 2026 release); Zerodha calculations
